hero.tagline: I listen to the problem and build the solution: an automated workflow, a website or an application. On my own, or with a team I put together for the project.

about.title: About Me
about.statement: I listen to the business problem and build the solution.
about.description: I am a software engineer with 5 years spent shipping production systems: Python and FastAPI on the server, React and Next.js on the client, and the AWS infrastructure underneath. I work with small and medium businesses that need a process automated, a site live, or an application built to fit. I always write a proposal with scope and deadline before starting, so you know what you are agreeing to.

gaming.title: Gaming
gaming.description: One of my passions is video games. From an early age, I've been drawn to good stories, great storytelling, and solving puzzles — one of the big reasons I chose this field.

fitness.title: Fitness
fitness.description: I believe balance between mind and body is key to dealing with everyday challenges. I try to stay as active as possible and maintain a healthy diet.

music.title: Music
music.description: I love all styles of music — every genre has its moment. Music has always had a meaningful impact on my life and work.

learning.title: Learning
learning.description: Learning about everything has always fascinated me. I'm always chasing something new — different subjects to master, not just in a professional sense.

description: Built and maintain a generative AI-powered support system that helps answer customer questions.
Built the self-service portal end to end, with a React/Next.js frontend and Python/FastAPI microservices.
Own the AWS cloud infrastructure behind these systems: Terraform (IaC), Docker and GitLab CI/CD.
Implemented authentication and application monitoring for the platform.
Developed and maintained the company's Python SDK, using pandas for data processing and Pytest for unit testing.
Built the interactive test suite in Playwright (Python and JavaScript) and load tests in Grafana K6.
Optimized data flows between Python services and Snowflake.
Built CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions and contributed to the data team's dashboards (SQL/Snowflake).
Built a proof of concept for automatic test-case generation from software requirements, as a full-stack application in Node.js with IBM Watson, deployed to the cloud.
